posts.author: Psychoholic42
posts.body: I'm looking for help with states. In my game, there's no battle log. I want it so that it shows a pop-up letting you know whether or not a state landed. If poison is used, I want it to either say (+poison) or (miss). I also want it to say (-Poison) when the state goes away.

posts.author: Son_ofHiro
posts.body: But I think there is a thing for that in the state tab at the database. Anyways if you want a plugin, I will recommend Yanfly's Battle Engine Core for you. And you might also consider adding the Yanfly's Battle Status Window.
